name: datapce
description: An advise-only model-routing ledger you can see (alias apex-router); never changes the model you chose. Writes only under ~/.apex-router and the plugin store; never stores prompt text, file contents or command text; no network calls; no telemetry to anyone.

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: auto opens the /apex pane when a session starts (the engine seats it once the terminal is wide enough); command opens it only on /apex; off never opens it.

budgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Spend per day the budget burn is measured against. 0 turns budget tracking off.

band.title: Status band
band.description: Show the one-line band above the prompt.

backendDir.title: Backend directory
backendDir.description: Where the optional apex-router backend keeps its files; the plugin writes its rows here too.
